memories.name: Larkspur sourdough starter feeding
memories.description: How the rye starter is fed
memories.content: Feed the rye starter twice a day at one part starter, one part flour and one part water by weight, and keep it at 24 C.

memories.name: Larkspur sourdough hydration
memories.description: Dough ratios for the country loaf
memories.content: The country loaf dough runs at 78 percent hydration with 2 percent salt.

memories.name: Copperfield bike chain wax
memories.description: Chain care for the touring bike
memories.content: Strip the chain with mineral spirits, then dip it in hot paraffin wax every 800 km.

memories.name: Copperfield tyre pressure
memories.description: Tyre setup for the gravel bike
memories.content: Run the 32 mm gravel tyres at 38 psi front and 42 psi rear.

memories.name: Tidewater kayak launch
memories.description: Where and when to launch the kayak
memories.content: Launch from the north slipway two hours before high tide to avoid the mudflats.

memories.name: Tidewater paddle float rescue
memories.description: Self rescue steps for the sea kayak
memories.content: Inflate the paddle float, lock it on the blade, and re-enter over the rear deck.

memories.name: Prefers metric units
memories.content: Use kilograms, kilometres and Celsius in every answer.

memories.name: Prefers short answers
memories.content: Lead with the answer in one sentence before any detail.

memories.name: Orchard pruning calendar
memories.description: When the fruit trees are pruned
memories.content: Prune the apple trees in late winter while dormant, and summer prune the plums after harvest.

memories.name: Orchard codling moth traps
memories.content: Hang pheromone traps in May and count the codling moths weekly until August.

memories.name: Harbourline chess opening repertoire
memories.content: Play the Caro-Kann against e4 and the Queen's Gambit Declined against d4.

memories.name: Harbourline chess endgame drills
memories.content: Drill king and pawn opposition and the Lucena position each Sunday.

memories.name: Moonbeam telescope collimation
memories.content: Collimate the Newtonian with a laser before every session and adjust the primary mirror screws last.

memories.name: Moonbeam dark sky site
memories.content: The Bortle 3 site is the reservoir car park, forty minutes east.

memories.name: Juniper home network VLANs
memories.content: IoT devices sit on VLAN 30 with no route to the workstation VLAN 10.

memories.name: Juniper backup rotation
memories.content: Keep three backup copies on two kinds of media with one copy off site, rotated monthly.

memories.name: Saffron risotto method
memories.content: Toast the arborio, add warm stock a ladle at a time, and finish with butter and parmesan.

memories.name: Saffron pantry substitutions
memories.content: Turmeric gives colour only and does not replace the saffron aroma.

memories.name: Quill fountain pen inks
memories.content: Iron gall ink needs a pen flush every two weeks to avoid corrosion.

memories.name: Marathon taper plan
memories.content: Cut weekly distance by a third three weeks out and keep one tempo run each week.

memories.name: Marathon fuelling
memories.content: Take a gel every 40 minutes from kilometre ten and practise it on long runs.

memories.name: Beekeeping hive inspection
memories.content: Inspect the brood frames every nine days in swarm season and look for queen cells.

memories.name: Beekeeping varroa treatment
memories.content: Treat the colony with oxalic acid in midwinter when it is broodless.

memories.name: Ceramics glaze firing
memories.content: Fire the celadon glaze to cone 10 in reduction.
